findings.title: Public exporter includes Git-ignored machine-local Codex configuration
Task integrity incorrectly uses retrieval file selection
Workflow governance is a standalone helper, not an integrated contract check
Application scope approval is not a separate required CI acceptance gate
Active feature flows are not automatically registered in readiness bindings
Candidate execution drops abstention before scoring
Promotion screening silently ignores unsupported coverage policy
Scored outputs are not bound to the generating candidate run
Skill retirement leaves stale Claude instructions discoverable
Python indexing loses top-level code outside symbol previews
Containment relationships and duplicate context crowd out useful evidence
Source-read response has no practical character budget
CI profiles conflate maintainer coverage with downstream optionality
Task schema rejects valid repeated command arguments
External candidate timeout leaves child processes running
Phase and activation information can be stale or incomplete
Current navigation documents contradict the shipped implementation
Presence and unit tests do not verify native skill use or end-to-end outcomes

interpretation: Local regression coverage is not an independent security audit, authenticated approval or hosted/native-client certification.
